notes.title: Ancings, a new paradigm for jrpgs games.
notes.notes: In this event we will explain the technical detail of intermediate turns and how this would benefit the creation of new strategies in a jrpg. Also, how this can lead to more choreographed combats, like those seen in an anime series.
